In a sunny garden lived Benny, the slowest snail of all. One morning, Grandma Ladybug had a very important job for him.
Please take this birthday leaf to Little Mouse, before the sun goes down. Benny smiled. "I'll get it there!"
Along came Rabbit. "Too slow, Benny! Watch me!" And off he zoomed. But Rabbit found some crunchy carrots, and stopped to munch.
Then came Squirrel. "Too slow, Benny! Watch me!" And off she scampered. But Squirrel found a pile of acorns, and stopped to play.
Benny didn't stop. Slow and steady, over the pebbles and under the ferns, he kept on going.
Just as the sun touched the hills, Benny reached Little Mouse's door. "Happy birthday!" The leaf was perfect.
Because slow is okay, when you never give up. The end.
